Site: Grandeza - TCPA Compliance Hardening for Contractors
URL: https://grandeza.io

## What We Do
Grandeza makes contractor intake provably TCPA-compliant. We help HVAC and plumbing businesses assess, remediate, and maintain compliance with the Telephone Consumer Protection Act across their SMS, voice, and web communication systems.

## Key Pages & Resources

### Free Assessment
- https://grandeza.io/scan - Free Grandeza Score (3-minute compliance scan)

### Compliance Guides & Education

### Services
- Hardening: One-time intake remediation ($1,500 + $149/month monitoring)
- Protected Intake: Managed compliant intake agent ($2,000 + $349/month)
- Guardian: Ongoing compliance monitoring

## Core Expertise
- TCPA compliance (Telephone Consumer Protection Act)
- SMS/text message compliance for contractors
- AI voice agent compliance
- Do Not Call (DNC) list screening and management
- Appointment reminder and dispatch communication compliance
- Consent capture and management systems
- Compliance auditing and hardening

## Main Audience
